name: supervisor + workers + verifier
description: A supervisor routes to one of three specialist workers, whose answer a verifier checks before delivery. Two workers share a model snapshot and the third does not, which makes the common-cause grouping visible in the cut sets.
provenance: A synthetic architecture written for this package's tutorials; not taken from a measured system.
